name: screen
title: world.screen
lead: Puts a wall of map frames, `width` by `height` frames (128 pixels each), in front of a wall; `at` is the top-left frame. Returns a Screen.
signature: world.screen(opts: { at: Vec3, facing: Facing | "up", up: Facing ?, width: number ?, height: number ?, glow: boolean ?, on_click: ((player: Player, x: number, y: number, button: "left" | "right") -> ())?, }) → Screen

params.name: opts
params.type: { at: Vec3 , facing: Facing | "up" , up: Facing ?, width: number ?, height: number ?, glow: boolean ?, on_click: ((player: Player , x: number , y: number , button: "left" | "right" ) -> ())?, }
